faqs.question: What is photoZseo?
faqs.answer: photoZseo is a set of tools for online sellers: an iPhone and iPad app that prepares product photos and listing data for 46 marketplaces, and a separate Chrome extension that collects product photos from product pages.

faqs.question: Which platforms does photoZseo run on?
faqs.answer: The app runs on iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 17 or later). The Chrome extension runs on desktop Google Chrome 116 or later. There is no Android or Mac app.

faqs.question: How much does photoZseo cost?
faqs.answer: The iPhone and iPad app has a free plan; paid plans are Starter $9.99/month, Pro $19.99/month and Business $49.99/month, with annual plans 40% cheaper and a 7-day free trial. The Chrome extension is free for up to 5 products and 10 new images per day; Pro is $7.99/month or $59/year and Team is $129/year.

faqs.question: Where is my data stored?
faqs.answer: App photos are processed on the device. The Chrome extension stores its library in the browser and has no photoZseo server or account.

faqs.question: Which marketplaces are supported?
faqs.answer: The app includes image presets and listing templates for 46 marketplaces plus social and ad platforms, including Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, Walmart, Trendyol, Hepsiburada and AliExpress. Names describe compatibility only; photoZseo is not affiliated with any marketplace.
